mapper.select:
SELECT T1.PORTFOLIO_ID code, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID name, T1.PORTFOLIO_NAME shortName, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID hidCode FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO T1 INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY T2 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T2.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T2.USER_ID = #{userId}
T1.PORTFOLIO_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')) or T1.PORTFOLIO_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%'))

SELECT T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, T6.ASSET_TYPE1 assetType1, T6.VDATE vdateAdd, T6.MDATE mdateAdd, T6.TERM_DAYS termDays, T6.TERM_DAYS2 termDays2, T6.TERM_DAYS repoTerm, T6.TERM_DAYS2 repoTerm2, T6.SETTLE_SPREED settleSpeed, T6.CASH_USEDATE availableDay, T6.SEC_ACCT_ID securitiesCust, T6.TERM_TYPE termType, T6.FIRST_UNIT_CPRICE firstprice, T6.FIRST_UNIT_CPRICE2 firstprice2, T1.CCY ccy, T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T3.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, T1.PS ps, T1.PRICE*100 price, T1.PRICE_MODEL priceModel, T1.ENTRUST_AMT*100 entrustAmt, T1.Entrust_Num * 100 entrustNum, T1.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, T1.CALENDAR_ID calendarId, T1.PRO_AVAILABLE_CASH proAvailableCash, T1.ACC_AVAILABLE_CASH accAvailableCash, T1.REMARK remark, T1.COUNTER_ID counterId, T1.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, T1.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo, T2.TRADER trader, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, T1.CHL_ID chlId FROM ETR_ENTRUST T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T6 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T6.ENTRUST_ID
T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}

select PRIN_AMT*-1 from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 inner join WFL_PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T2 on T1.TRADE_ID = T2. TRADE_ID inner join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T3 on T1.TRADE_ID = T3.TRADE_ID
T2.PA_BUSS_TYPE = #{repoType} AND T1.VDATE <= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND T1.MDATE >= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = #{manageId} AND T3.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}

select PRIN_AMT * -1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 inner join PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T2 on T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID inner join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T3 on T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID
T2.PA_BUSS_TYPE = #{repoType} AND T1.VDATE <= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND T1.MDATE >= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = #{manageId} AND T3.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}
